problem: Production language switching reached /en/prijzen but the English route still rendered the Dutch pricing H1.
root_cause: Production had STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 while the versioned English cache was incomplete. build-localized-routes.mjs therefore emitted /en routes from Dutch source with translations=null instead of failing the release.
prevention: Production static English generation must use the configured translation provider whenever the versioned cache is incomplete.
Provider failure must fail the production build; /en routes may never silently publish Dutch source text.
Deploy previews remain provider-independent and offline.
Terminal release proof requires NL to EN to NL browser roundtrip on homepage, pricing and systems/koppelingen.

evidence.browser_failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1
